name: Soyuz-2.1b (RD-107A / RD-108A / RD-0124), no Fregat — TIMELINE mode

propellant_kg.derived: LOX 27,900 kg + RP-1 11,260 kg (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Soyuz-2 Block B/V/G/D)

dry_kg.src: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Soyuz-2 (empty mass 3,784 kg). Gross mass on the same table is 44,413 kg, which is 1,469 kg above empty+propellant; that gap is not added.

cutoff_s.src: https://www.russianspaceweb.com/progress-ms-19.html (Stage I engine cutoff 117.418 s). BORROWED from a Soyuz-2.1a Progress flight. Wikipedia lists a generic 118 s booster burn.

separation_s.src: https://www.russianspaceweb.com/progress-ms-19.html (Stage I separation 117.848 s, about 43 km). BORROWED.

propellant_kg.derived: LOX 63,800 kg + RP-1 26,300 kg (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Soyuz-2 Block A). Empty 6,545 + this propellant is 96,645 kg, 3,120 kg under the table gross of 99,765 kg; the gap is not added.

diameter_m.src: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Soyuz-2 (core diameter 2.95 m). Drag in this sim uses the maximum stage diameter, so the 10.3 m booster span is not the reference area.

cutoff_s.src: https://www.russianspaceweb.com/progress-ms-19.html (Stage II engine cutoff 286.399 s). BORROWED from a Soyuz-2.1a Progress flight. Wikipedia lists a generic 286 s core burn.

separation_s.src: https://www.russianspaceweb.com/progress-ms-19.html (Stage II separation 287.419 s, about 143 km). BORROWED.

propellant_kg.derived: LOX 17,800 kg + RP-1 7,600 kg (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Soyuz-2 Block I). The same tanks are on 2.1a and 2.1b.

thrust_sl_N.assumption: Set equal to the vacuum thrust. RD-0124 lights after core separation, above the atmosphere. A sea-level figure is not used.

ignition_s.src: https://www.russianspaceweb.com/progress-ms-19.html (Stage III ignition 286.159 s, before core cutoff: hot staging). BORROWED from a Soyuz-2.1a Progress flight. No Soyuz-2.1b Progress timeline was found.

cutoff_s.derived: Ignition 286.159 s plus the Wikipedia generic RD-0124 burn of 270 s (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Soyuz-2). The Progress MS-19 cutoff 525.45 s is an RD-0110 time and is not used as this stage's cutoff.

mass_kg.assumption: No Progress MS fairing mass was found on Roscosmos, Energia, or the Soyuz-2 Wikipedia tables. 1,500 kg is a round stand-in in the Soyuz payload-fairing class. It is not a measured Progress shroud mass.

jettison_time_s.src: https://www.russianspaceweb.com/progress-ms-19.html (payload fairing separation 183.079 s, about 91 km). BORROWED from a Soyuz-2.1a Progress flight.

kick_duration_s.assumption: Soyuz pitch-kick duration is not on the Progress timeline used here.

header_notes: Stage masses, thrust and Isp are the Soyuz-2 Wikipedia tables (2.1b third stage is RD-0124). Empty+propellant does not equal the table gross masses; the gaps are not added.
Event times are BORROWED from the Progress MS-19 Soyuz-2.1a sequence on RussianSpaceWeb, because no Soyuz-2.1b Progress timeline with times was found. Wikipedia's generic burns are 118 / 286 / 270 s.

cd.assumption: Not published. Same generic slender-launcher Cd used for Falcon 9 in this repo. Not fitted.

vertical_rise_s.basis: ASSUMPTION bound (Soyuz pitch-over time unpublished for this flight)
